payload.credit_html: "A new hyperodapedontine rhynchosaur from a cynodont-dominated site (Upper Triassic) of southern Brazil"
payload.description_html: Left partial lower jaw of Isodapedon varzealis (CAPPA/UFSM 0371). (A) Photographs, interpretative digital drawings and three-dimensional models from surface scans of the medial view of the lower jaw. (B) Photographs, interpretative digital drawings and three-dimensional model from surface scans of the lateral view of the lower jaw. Abbreviations: a, angular; amf, anterior mental foramen; cor, coronoid; d, dentary; pa, prearticular; pmf, posterior mental foramen; sa, surangular; sp, splenial. Black arrow points anteriorly.
